'''Li-Suun Niik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] operating on the banking [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].

==Biography==
The details of Niik's origin and how he became the biggest criminal mastermind on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was known only to him. It was not known whether he was a native of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] or an offworlder, furthering suspicions that his name was just a moniker. His whereabouts were hidden, only appearing to people who have impressed him considerably.<ref name="article" />

Niik mainly dealt with electronic theft and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] precious metals like [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. He built his criminal [[Li-Suun Niik's Criminal Organization|organization]] with only a small group of loyal people numbering in hundreds, quite small compared to galactic standards. He compensated by dealing with his contacts working for the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]] like [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Smalyun]] and Depositor Councilwoman [[Balazausa]], or hiring offworld [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] when needed.<ref name="article" />

It was believed that he masterminded or had a hand in almost all major crimes committed on the planet. The organization remained independent and never gave a portion or selling out their operation to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] or [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Niik also held the distinction of being the only individual in [[Aargauun]] history to deprive the Bank of Aargau of more than one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and evade arrest.<ref name="article" />

Unknown to most of his operatives including his closest advisers, Niik was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitive]], which would explain his success through the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. It is not known whether [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] knew of his connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during their visits to Aargau, but he was strangely left alone without repercussions.<ref name="article" />

==Powers and abilities==
Training himself, Niik was able to use several different [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] like [[Mind trick/Legends|Mind trick]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|Telekinesis]], [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]], [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]], [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Grip|Force grip]] and Alter.<ref name="article" />

He could speak Ancient [[Aargauese]], [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Binary/Legends|Binary]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] and the [[Sith (language)|Sith]].<ref name="article" />
